responsibility: Declares lightweight utility visitors for the Rust typechecker. Its main role is ImplTypeIterator, a callback-driven walker over impl blocks that exposes type-alias impl items to clients such as associated-type setup code without requiring a full general-purpose traversal.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ImplTypeIterator utility visitor and its callback-based API for scanning impl blocks for type aliases; the paired .cc file contains the concrete traversal and callback invocation logic.
